mods.name: publish-guard
mods.description: Asks before a package is published: npm, pnpm, yarn or bun publish, cargo publish, twine upload, gem push, poetry or uv publish. Dry runs pass.

mods.name: tag-guard
mods.description: Asks before release tags go to a remote: git push --tags, --follow-tags or --mirror, a push of a tag ref, and a push that deletes a remote tag. Dry runs pass. Reads tags with git.

mods.name: deploy-guard
mods.description: Asks before a production deploy: vercel --prod, netlify deploy --prod, firebase deploy, fly deploy, gcloud app deploy, eb deploy, heroku rollback, serverless deploy to prod.

mods.name: db-reset-guard
mods.description: Asks before a framework wipes a database: prisma migrate reset, rails or rake db:drop and db:reset, alembic downgrade, django flush, supabase db reset, knex rollback --all.

mods.name: ssh-guard
mods.description: Asks before a private key in .ssh is read, authorized_keys or the SSH config is changed, or ssh-keygen would overwrite a key. Public keys and ssh -i pass. Reads HOME with printenv.

mods.name: cron-guard
mods.description: Asks before scheduled jobs or services are wiped or stopped: crontab -r, crontab replaced from stdin or a file, launchctl unload or bootout, systemctl stop, disable or mask.

mods.name: upload-guard
mods.description: Asks before local files go to a remote host: scp or rsync to host:path, piped input to nc, curl -T, sftp put. Local copies, downloads and localhost pass.

mods.name: registry-push-guard
mods.description: Asks before an image or chart is pushed to a registry: docker push, docker buildx --push, podman push, helm push, gcloud artifacts docker push. Local registries pass.

mods.name: release-pack
mods.description: Asks before a release leaves your machine: package publish, tag push, production deploy and registry push guards in one mod. The tag guard reads tags with git.

mods.name: ship-safe-pack
mods.description: The release-pack guards plus db-reset-guard and upload-guard: asks before publish, tag push, production deploy, registry push, database wipes and file uploads. Reads tags with git.
